notes:
After coding: clearer, more honest results. "No fault came back" only shows when every module answered again; a module that did not answer is named. A clear that stopped part way says exactly what was cleared. If you leave the question open for a while, the faults are read again before anything is cleared.
Service functions: the car network map no longer marks every module as not answering on some gateways, and battery readings no longer repeat.
